subject.title: Dashboard: stateful notes widget — the first consumer of widget write-back

question: Should this notes consumer proceed only after the dashboard write-back stack moves storage to plugin KV/SQLite and clears security proof, or may maintainers accept the current JSON-state/write-back exception for this dashboard feature?
rationale: This PR depends on a new persistent state model and a trusted parent write-back path; automation can identify defects, but cannot approve the storage/security exception or decide whether to pause behind the open predecessor stack.

options.title: Require storage and proof first
options.body: Hold this PR until widget state uses the approved storage layer or has an explicit exception, the notes sync bug is fixed, and live notes proof is added.

options.title: Approve an explicit exception
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can intentionally accept the JSON state path and current write-back boundary, then review the remaining notes behavior fixes.

options.title: Pause behind the stack
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer review until the sandbox and write-back predecessor PRs land or are rejected.

recommendation.title: Require storage and proof first
recommendation.body: Hold this PR until widget state uses the approved storage layer or has an explicit exception, the notes sync bug is fixed, and live notes proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest individual routing signal from current-main policy and plugin-tab history; secops should still review the dependency and security boundary.
